display_name: Behavioral Subscale: Number of items answered without missing (Range: 0-6)
description:
The behavioral score is based on 6 items from the Pediatric Sleep Questionnaire. A higher score indicates more in-attention and hyperactivity. [Chervin et al, 2000 (PubMed ID: 10733617)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/10733617)

[Search for all PSQ variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/datasets/pats/variables?search=psq)
